positioning: Present Franklin Navigator as an established Franklin-focused community resource. Do not use launch, new-service, early-adopter, first-wave, or special-origin-member language, and do not make unsupported claims about how long the service has existed.

emails.subject: Your Franklin Navigator profile
emails.message:
Hi {{Outreach_Greeting}},

Franklin Navigator is a local community resource focused on helping Franklin residents discover and connect with local businesses, professionals, organizations, and services.

Your business has a Franklin Navigator profile with useful public information to help local residents find you and understand what you offer.

Keeping your basic factual information accurate is free. You can request corrections or ask us to remove your profile from public view at no cost.

If you'd like to enhance your presence, optional Franklin Navigator Community Membership is $35/year and renews annually until canceled. Membership gives you tools to make your profile more complete and useful to local residents, improve your local visibility, and support business growth.

Review your Franklin Navigator profile, claim or manage it, and see the optional Community Membership path here:
{{Profile_URL}}

If you have any questions, just reply to this email. I'd be happy to help you review your profile or explain what Community Membership adds.

Review your Franklin Navigator profile, claim or manage it, and see the optional Community Membership path here:
{{Profile_URL}}

If you'd like, just reply and I can help you review what's currently shown or answer any questions about membership.
